description: Indicative euro range for a clearance job from the confirmed method. Not a fixed price. The fixed price follows the free viewing. If volume or confirmation is missing, quoted is false and no amount is returned. Do not calculate the range yourself.

areaM2.description: Floor area in square metres. Used only when a conversion factor is stored.

floor.description: Floor number. 0 is the ground floor.

halteverbot.description: True when a no-parking zone is needed

lift.description: True when a lift is available.

offering.description: Service name, for example Wohnung, Keller, Haushalt, Messie

postalCode.description: Vienna postal code, four digits, form 1dd0

rooms.description: Room count. Used only when a conversion factor is stored.

rush.description: True when the date is urgent
